description: Upload a local file (image, audio, or a reference clip) to the project library. Returns the name for @mentions. A library picture referenced as @name reaches the video model exactly as it is — to put a face in front of a video model, make it a character's portrait (create_character): that lays the anti-moderation grain on it. A clip (mp4/mov, 2–30 s, 480p or 720p) mentioned as @name goes to Seedance as a reference video — motion, camera movement, pacing, an effect — and its seconds are billed as input on top of the take; pass durationSec (and width/height) so the studio can check the limits before any money moves.

durationSec.description: length of an audio or video file in seconds; measured here with ffprobe (video) or from the file (mp3/wav) when omitted

height.description: frame height of a clip in px (measured with ffprobe when omitted)

width.description: frame width of a clip in px (measured with ffprobe when omitted)

name: upload_asset
